title: 轮播
summary: 一组画面只说了会换。先定是平移、淡入、木马、叠卡、翻页、手风琴、360 还是视差。
summaryEn: A set of frames only says it will change. First decide whether the cut is a slide, a fade, a coverflow, a stack, a page turn, an accordion, a 360 spin, or parallax.
asksEn: How does this set of frames advance?

links.when: 切画面不是通知跑马灯
links.whenEn: advancing frames is not a notice marquee
advancing frames is not a masonry skeleton

links.when: 切下一张不是提交记得程度
links.whenEn: advancing a frame is not committing how well you remembered
